Stable Call/Cancel/End positions; no unlock; 11 gesture transition/retirement cases plus same-input positive paths, terminal permissions and late purpose actions.

16 real layout combinations: 320x480,844x390,768x1024,1024x768 x English/Chinese x 100/150% semantic font scale; viewport/scroll clip minimum size and separation.
